entries.zh: 至额：达到额数、足额；字面亦可解「及于额头」（西栏残迹难辨，义未定）
entries.en: to reach the full amount/quota; literally also readable as 'reach the forehead' (Spanish headword illegible, sense undetermined)
entries.notes: 西栏「Farea, ycunquilla」无法确解且一处声调号污损难辨（T99），据汉字与闽南音作低置信存疑释义

entries.zh: 床：睡觉的床铺；木板床、板铺
entries.en: bed; board bed / raised wooden sleeping platform

entries.zh: 床梯：登床用的踏梯、床边小梯（高架床铺所用）；亦或指床架横档、床屉
entries.en: bed-steps or bed-ladder (for climbing onto a raised bed); possibly the bed-frame slats

entries.zh: 触口：口吃、说话结巴（西栏注：因舌上之罪而结巴）
entries.en: to stammer, to stutter (lit. 'the mouth trips'; glossed in Spanish as 'from sinning with the tongue')
entries.notes: 仅一处声调号污损难辨（T99），依规程降低置信；西栏 tartamudear 与汉字触口、闽南音互证清晰，义为口吃

entries.zh: 触舌：舌头打绊、说话结巴（同上「触口」，指口吃）
entries.en: to stammer (lit. 'the tongue trips'); same sense as the preceding 'mouth trips'

entries.zh: 重句：重复语句、一句话反复重说（指口吃之状）
entries.en: to repeat the sentence over and over (describing stammering)
entries.notes: 闽南栏后段覆写残损（[残]）且声调号污损难辨（T99），西栏圈注重写，低置信

entries.zh: 重咀：重复口中言语、翻来覆去地说（指口吃结巴）
entries.en: to repeat one's words over and over (stammering)
entries.notes: 闽南栏内混写西文「…repite m[uchas] vezes」（重复多次），为口吃释义之佐证

entries.en: [Entry struck through in the manuscript; Chinese and Hokkien columns blank — gloss undetermined]
entries.notes: 西栏「Fararagvelo f.」整行涂销，其余三栏皆空，无从释义

entries.zh: 粗子：粗的（东西）、粗条粗料；粗糙不精细
entries.en: the coarse one(s); coarse stuff (of strips or material), rough rather than fine
entries.notes: 西栏「Farfaror」未能解读，义据汉字「粗」与闽南音；下两条同

entries.zh: 粗篾：粗竹篾（剖开的粗竹条，编篮筐席箔之用）；粗
entries.en: coarse bamboo slat / split bamboo strip (for basketry); coarse

entries.zh: 比粗：比粗细、较量粗细（相较其粗细程度）
entries.en: to compare in coarseness / to match in thickness

entries.zh: 估：估量、估价（估算价值、数量）
估工：估工价、估算活计工程的工钱工量
entries.en: to estimate the work/labour, to price up the job (Sp. tasar la obra)

entries.zh: 估钱：估算钱数（可扣除、可折扣之数）
entries.en: to estimate the money, the amount that may be deducted/discounted
entries.notes: 一声调号污损难辨（T99），依规程降低置信；西栏「tasar lo q(ue) puede descontar」与汉字估钱互证

entries.zh: 盖：覆盖、盖上；盖子（器物之盖）；西栏又一义「fapa del Gov」疑指官长钤印之盖，未详
entries.en: to cover; lid, cover; also 'tapa del gobernador' (governor's stamp/seal? — uncertain)
entries.notes: 「Gov」缩写依赖推断（gobernador），其搭配义未详，故中等置信

entries.zh: 合盖：合上盖子、把盖子合拢盖好
entries.en: to close the lid, to put the cover on
entries.notes: 西栏空缺，义据汉字「合盖」与闽南音互证

entries.zh: 冻头：冻、上冻（字面「冻＋头」；西栏空缺，确指未详）
entries.notes: 西栏空缺且声调号污损难辨（T99），「冻头」确义难以定夺
